Name: Totems to Runestones
Author: LinSterling
Description:
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
Pretty much what is says on the tin. I wanted to wipe out the fugly vanilla totems from my game but I wasn't satisfied with what I found on Nexus. So here we are.
At first I was just gonna make stone slabs with random doodles but then I thought I should use real runes and, lamely, I landed on Elder Futhark. I managed to make a bit of sense out of it and picked somewhat appropriate runes (at least I think so).

Also I changed the actual item names to runestones, feck them totems.
As of 1.1.1 item renaming is optional. On by default. You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to turn it off if for whatever reason you want original item names.
Same goes for descriptions. Vanilla totem descriptions are fine but I changed any instances of word "totem" in descriptions from some mods. On by default.

As of 1.3.0 there's a saturation toggle. I think my initial sprites were too pale but maybe it's just me. Saturated by default. Previews are desaturated though because I'm stupid.

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Supported totems + runes and meanings[/size][/color][/b]
Vanilla runestones use base runes and modded ones use bindrunes (several base runes combined). I figured this was the correct approach.
  🔷 [b]Vanilla[/b]
         🔹 [b][color=#6aa84f]Farm [/color]- Othala (ᛟ)[/b] [i](ancestral land, home, inheritance)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#900000]Mountain [/color]- Eihwaz (ᛇ)[/b] [i](resilience, endurance)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#1155cc]Beach [/color]- Laguz (ᛚ)[/b] [i](water, ocean, flow)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#ffd966]Desert [/color]- Sowilo (ᛊ)[/b] [i](sun, energy)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#e69138]Island [/color]- Kenaz (ᚲ)[/b] [i](fire, knowledge, technical skill)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#9fc5e8]Rain [/color]- Hagalaz (ᚺ)[/b] [i](hail, disruption)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#9900ff]Treasure [/color]- Fehu (ᚠ)[/b] [i](wealth, luck, money)[/i]

Mods under the spoiler
[spoiler]And here we go with trying to piece together freakish bindrunes in a teeny-weeny little-wittle tinsy-winsy square. I did what I could but basically from this point on there be nonsense. I'm doing a lot of interpretive bullshitting with these, drawing connections like "divine wisdom = owls". If you happen to actually know this stuff - feel free to correct me and suggest more appropriate runes I can use.

  🔷 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/url]
         🔹 [b][color=#9fc5e8]Sun[/color] - Sowilo (ᛊ) + Dagaz (ᛞ)[/b] [i](sun + day)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#9fc5e8]Wind[/color] - Tiwaz (ᛏ) + Raidho (ᚱ)[/b] [i](direction, sky + movement, breath)[/i]

  🔷 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787][b]East Scarp[/b][/url]
         🔹 [b][color=#dd7e6b]East Scarp[/color] - Mannaz (ᛗ) + Othala (ᛟ)[/b] [i](mankind, community + home)[/i]

  🔷 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600][b]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/b][/url]
         🔹 [b][color=#674ea7]Glimsap [/color]-  Ansuz (ᚨ) + Eihwaz (ᛇ) + Othala (ᛟ)[/b] [i](divine wisdom (for owl, original item is an owl carving)  + resilience, endurance (for mountain) + home)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#76a5af]Forest Pond[/color] - Perthro (ᛈ) +  Wunjo (ᚹ) + Laguz (ᛚ)[/b] [i](secrets, mystery, unknown + joy, harmony (I like this rune for junimos) + water)[/i]
  ❗NOTE: renaming and description changes are off by default, you have to turn them on yourself if you want. (This is my way of honouring Lumisteria's preferences.)

  🔷 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883][b]Eli and Dylan[/b][/url]
         🔹 [b][color=#38761d]Old Woods[/color] - Perthro (ᛈ) + Wunjo (ᚹ) + Eihwaz (ᛇ)[/b] [i](secrets, mystery, unknown + joy, harmony (junimo again) + resilience, endurance (for old resilient trees in this context)[/i]
         🔹 [b][color=#ff0000]Chaos[/color] - Thurisaz (ᚦ) + Hagalaz (ᚺ)[/b] [i](conflict, power + disruption, unpredictable fate)[/i]
  ❗NOTE: I couldn't patch the totem in the middle of the guest room since it's embedded into map tileset and trying to mess with it would've been difficult and way too intrusive. We'll just have to chalk it up to this totem being a weirdass experimental object.
Also, chaos animation would've made me pull out my hair but luckily I don't have any hair. And the animation is bad.
One other thing - warp totems are mentioned in some dialogues. Rather heavily in Eli's case as totems are a part of his story. I'm still not sure how to make sense of it so for now he will still say "totem".

  🔷[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43648][b]NPC Warp Totem[/b][/url]
          🔹 [b][color=#a64d79]NPC[/color] - Gebo (ᚷ) + Mannaz (ᛗ)[/b] [i](gift, generosity + mankind, community, family, kin)
[/i]   ❗NOTE: the problem with binding Gebo and Mannaz together is that it ends up looking exactly like Mannaz without any modifications lmao. At least the way I do it. Could've used different colours but that's not how I did the other bindrunes... So yes, this rune is basically just MAN. Your favourite MAN. Or woMAN. Just know that there's supposed to be a little Gebo in there.

  🔷[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635][b]Cape Stardew[/b][/url]
[b]           🔹 [/b][color=#1155cc][b]Cape [/b][/color][b]- [/b] [b]Laguz (ᛚ) + [/b] [b]Raidho (ᚱ) [/b][i](water, ocean + movement, breath, journey)[/i]
[b]          🔹 [color=#45818e]Cape Island [/color]- [/b][b]Laguz (ᛚ) + [/b][b]Perthro (ᛈ) + [/b][b]Fehu (ᚠ) [/b][i](water, ocean + secrets, mystery, unknown + treasure, wealth)[/i]

  🔷 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111][b]Sunberry Village[/b][/url]
[b]          🔹 [/b][color=#ffe599][b]Sunberry[/b][/color][b] - Sowilo [/b][b](ᛊ)[/b] [b]+ Wunjo [/b][b](ᚹ)[/b] [b]+ Othala [/b][b](ᛟ)[/b] [i](sun + joy, harmony + home)[/i]
  ❗NOTE: ended up looking like there's a little bird sitting on top of the rune 😭 Happy little accidents![/spoiler]
[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/b]
  1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]
  2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
  1. Download
  2. Unzip
  3. Put "Totems to Runestones" into Stardew Valley\Mods
  4. Should work unless I borked something (in that case, let me know)
  5. Enjoy!
  6. Maybe endorse this mod if you liked it? :3

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]Future updates[/size][/color][/b]
  📖 most likely some sprite tweaks
  📖 change crafting recipes to require stone (if my pea brain can figure out how)
  📖 [s]what if I retextured the warp statues too?[/s] :0 aaah brain stop it, it's gonna be so much work
  📖 compatibility with various mods, feel free to make suggestions! I already have my beady eyes on:
          📌 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] (waiting for permission)
          📌 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30535]Green Rain Totem[/url] (waiting for permission)
